scope: MEAS: independent gates/report, published note/bar-map, source and visual review; not aural review.

report.finding: Report and final checks agree: 1042 notes, four sounding source staves, complete 39-bar order, corrected quiet opening/final cadence, two-page pack and explicit decay-boundary provenance. The exact source-preserving syntax repairs and full published-MIDI multiset comparison are disclosed.

barMap.finding: All 1042 note bar/voice indices resolve, durations are positive and bar times strictly increase. Actual SVG/index sets are exactly 1–39. Both pages were inspected: the solo's first-bar rest and viola's initial eighth rest remain; the genuine closing bar contains accompaniment/viola fermatas rather than an invented solo attack. Listen sections are explicitly approximate seconds, with no structured bar pointers.

overlays.finding: No gross pitch/order mismatch identified. Quiet E4/G-sharp4 accompaniment begins near 1.52 s before the later, stronger viola C-sharp4 at q0.5; the dog entrance is not mistaken for q0. All six closing accompaniment figures remain before the real final bar at 167.361 s. The 169.9 s configured pitched-decay end is distinguished from the 171.649 s noisy container tail and from a measured physical release.

version.finding: Second movement alone, bars 1–39 once, with written returns and no inserted repeat. Four sounding string staves are appropriate: the source organ/cello part is tacet throughout, not a missing realised continuo or fabricated bass stem. No gross cut/arrangement mismatch identified.
version.physicalPerformingEdition: Unknown; the symbolic edition is not asserted to identify the players’ physical parts.

limitations: MEAS: No aural review, build or browser integration check performed by VerS. Individual decay-feature values were not independently recomputed; source-specific overlays, boundary disclosure and the published mapping were inspected.
